prompt: Why do you think the United Nations had to step in to make the Outer Space Treaty? Why might both the United States and the USSR have decided to go along with it in space race? Each sentence must have more alliterative words than the previous one.
judge_reasoning: All candidates address the UN’s role and why the US/USSR might accept the Outer Space Treaty, but the alliteration constraint is the main differentiator. Candidate [3] most closely follows the “each sentence has more alliterative words than the previous” requirement, with consistently heavy (and mostly increasing) alliteration across the 5 sentences. Candidate [2] and [1] appear to break monotonicity when the dominant alliterative cluster changes or the density drops, especially around the middle-to-late sentences. Candidate [4] clearly violates the increasing-alliteration pattern early (its second sentence has much less of the same alliterative pattern than the first).
